content: Google Drive API v3 from browser: two storage strategies. drive.file scope = per-file, non-sensitive (streamlined OAuth verification), files are user-visible and app only sees files it created/opened. drive.appdata scope + spaces=appDataFolder = hidden per-app folder for config/private data the user does not directly browse. For an own-cloud database app where the user should see/manage their DB folder, drive.file (or full drive scope) is appropriate; appDataFolder suits hidden app metadata. Verification burden is lower with drive.file.
